question:
Raju starts from point A and drives 9 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn,

 drives 7 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He

 takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and

 towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are

 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given,

Raju starts from point A and drives 9 km towards the west.

He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 11 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P.
